display.purpose: Main timetable card title (학급 시간표, 주간 시간표, 공유 공강 시간표).

headline.purpose: Top editorial school year and semester header.

title.purpose: Subject name inside each timetable cell.

body.purpose: Mode tabs, top row toggles, and table headers.

label.purpose: Quick selection chips, grade badges, and status pills (minimum 12px).

shadows.name: control-elevation
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for top-row search bar, semester dropdown, and active toggles.

shadows.name: mode-tray-elevation
shadows.purpose: Prominent framing for the 4 primary mode tabs.

motion.name: ease-snappy
motion.purpose: Instant-feeling hover and active state transitions.

components.name: Mode Tab Button (Active)
components.description: High-visibility active mode tab inside the green-bordered mode tray.
components.css: .ds-mode-tab-active { height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; background: #027046; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #015434; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(2, 112, 70, 0.28); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Mode Tab Button (Inactive)
components.description: Card-styled inactive mode tab with crisp mint border and hover lift.
components.css: .ds-mode-tab { height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; background: #FFFFFF; color: #015434; border: 1.5px solid #B6E2CE; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(2, 112, 70, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.14s ease; } .ds-mode-tab:hover { border-color: #027046; color: #027046; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Top Row Toggle Button
components.description: 46px full-height toggle button aligned with the semester dropdown and search input.
components.css: .ds-top-toggle { height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; background: #EAF6F0; color: #015434; border: 2px solid #027046; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(2, 112, 70, 0.1); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Quick Selection Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped class or teacher selection button inside the n×10 grid.
components.css: .ds-q-chip { padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: #FFFFFF; color: #313339; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s ease; } .ds-q-chip:hover { border-color: #027046; background: #EAF6F0; }

narrative.overview: 학교 현장의 복잡한 시간표 데이터를 한눈에 판독할 수 있도록 에디토리얼 인쇄물의 명쾌한 타이포그래피 위계와 고대비 격자 시스템을 결합한 디자인 언어입니다.
keyCharacteristics: Single Emerald Green (#027046) + Stone Gray (#313339) high-contrast editorial hierarchy
46px unified top control row with instant 0ms Chosung search
High-visibility 4-mode tab tray and n×10 fixed selection grid

rules.name: The Single Brand Green Rule
rules.body: Use #027046 as the sole primary accent color and #313339 for structural borders and shared-free highlights.

rules.name: The 12px Typography Floor
rules.body: Never render any label, chip, or badge below 12px to guarantee legibility on classroom displays and prints.

dos: Do maintain 46px height across all 1st-row controls (.top-toggle-btn, .project-select-wrap, .search-input-wrap).
Do keep all text and chip labels at 12px or above.
donts: Don't include hardcoded dummy timetable data.
Don't show search/control bars in @media print output.
